mapper.sql: ID, BUSINESS_TYPE, BUSINESS_ID, RETRY_COUNT, MAX_RETRY_COUNT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, NEXT_RETRY_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.RETRY_LOG WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' AND RETRY_COUNT < MAX_RETRY_COUNT AND NEXT_RETRY_TIME <= #{currentTime} ORDER BY NEXT_RETRY_TIME ASC
SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.RETRY_LOG WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' AND RETRY_COUNT >= MAX_RETRY_COUNT
SELECT FROM CLOUDWALK.RETRY_LOG WHERE STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT BUSINESS_TYPE, COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as success, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pending FROM CLOUDWALK.RETRY_LOG WHERE CREATE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY BUSINESS_TYPE
SELECT RETRY_COUNT, COUNT(*) as count FROM CLOUDWALK.RETRY_LOG WHERE CREATE_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY RETRY_COUNT ORDER BY RETRY_COUNT
